source_policy.fallback_rule: GitHub/yfinance, FinMind and TAIFEX may fill null fields only when the observation belongs to the same specified trade date/session date. Never silently overwrite a non-null canonical value or use a different trade date.
source_policy.trade_date_rule: Sunday 2026-09-06 in Taipei: no new U.S. cash or Taiwan cash session. Latest completed U.S. cash session is 2026-09-04; latest official Taiwan FX/cash/futures regular session is 2026-09-04. TAIFEX after-hours window 2026-09-04 15:00–2026-09-05 05:00 belongs to session_trade_date 2026-09-07.
source_policy.uncertainty_rule: Keep null when an exact same-instrument final cannot be independently verified. Never blend observations from different trade dates or different futures contracts.

breaking_news.headline: Foxconn says Q3 should beat market expectations on AI strength
breaking_news.summary: Foxconn said August revenue hit a record NT$921.8B, up 51.98% year over year, and stronger AI demand plus seasonal ICT momentum improved Q3 visibility.
breaking_news.market_impact: Fresh weekend confirmation that AI-server demand remains strong after semiconductor outperformance Friday.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Directly positive read-through for Taiwan AI server, power, cooling, PCB and component supply chains.

breaking_news.headline: TCS unit plans up to $7.4B, 1GW AI data-center campus in Hyderabad
breaking_news.summary: TCS subsidiary HyperVault and partners plan up to INR700B ($7.41B) for a 1GW AI campus supporting high-density GPU training and inference.
breaking_news.market_impact: Shows global AI infrastructure capex is broadening geographically and beyond U.S. hyperscalers.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Supports medium-term demand for AI servers, networking, liquid cooling and power systems.

breaking_news.headline: Middle East oil risk escalates over Iranian tanker strikes
breaking_news.summary: U.S.-Iran hostilities escalated around Iranian oil tankers and Kharg Island; U.S. Labor Day gasoline prices are at record levels amid supply disruption fears.
breaking_news.market_impact: Weekend risk premium could push crude and inflation expectations higher when futures reopen.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Higher oil and U.S. yields would be a valuation headwind for high-multiple tech while raising input and transport costs.

breaking_news.headline: Semiconductors decouple positively from broad U.S. market
breaking_news.summary: SOX rose 3.37% while the S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow declined after strong payrolls; AMD +4.69%, TSM ADR +2.85%, NVDA +0.83%.
breaking_news.market_impact: AI/semiconductor relative strength is improving even under higher-rate pressure.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Constructive Monday setup, reinforced by TX night-session +1.01%, but must be weighed against geopolitical oil risk.

breaking_news.headline: Strong August payrolls leave Fed hike risk alive ahead of inflation week
breaking_news.summary: August payrolls rose 162K versus roughly 56K consensus, with unemployment at 4.1%; rates markets raised September hike odds before trimming them.
breaking_news.market_impact: PPI and CPI now become the main macro catalysts for the Sep 15-16 Fed meeting.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Higher U.S. yields remain the key valuation cap for AI growth stocks.

narration_points: 週末沒有新的美股現貨交易，所有市場價格仍鎖定9月4日，不用週末即時或不同交易日資料覆蓋。
強勁非農推高利率預期，S&P 500、Nasdaq、Dow收跌，但SOX大漲3.37%，AMD、TSM ADR、NVIDIA逆勢上漲，AI半導體相對強度明顯改善。
台指期9月7日歸屬夜盤官方收47,182點、上漲473點或1.01%，與費半走強互相呼應；夜盤OI官方欄位為'-'，不可拿日盤OI冒充。
週末新增兩個AI需求驗證：鴻海8月營收創紀錄、稱Q3可望優於市場預期；TCS規劃74億美元1GW AI資料中心。
但中東油運風險在週末再升高，WTI最近收91.48美元，能源通膨可能重新推高殖利率，形成AI多頭最大的宏觀逆風。
下週一美股休市，真正方向點集中9月10日PPI與Oracle/Adobe財報、9月11日CPI；通膨結果將直接影響9月Fed升息風險。
